cases.question: In chapter one, what unusual thing about the White Rabbit made Alice follow it? Please answer briefly.
cases.expected: The rabbit took a watch from its waistcoat-pocket; Alice had never seen this and followed out of curiosity.

cases.question: In chapter five, what do the two sides of the mushroom do to Alice? Please answer in one sentence.
cases.expected: One side makes her taller; the other makes her shorter.

cases.question: Why is it always six o clock at the tea party? Please answer briefly.
cases.expected: The Hatter quarrelled with personified Time after the Queen accused him of murdering time; Time will no longer do what he asks, leaving it always six and tea-time.

cases.question: According to this book, what is the exact annual salary of Alice's father?
cases.expected: Acknowledge insufficient evidence; do not invent a salary or claim to have searched the web.

scope: Small manual acceptance smoke set; not the proposed 25-question retrieval benchmark. See the acceptance report for actual observed results.
